This implies a chain of regulatory interactions where orlistat may influence the activity of Regulatory protein E2, which then modulates the function of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The evidence suggests a possible mechanistic link, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it relies on indirect relationships through intermediate targets, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct involvement of orlistat in this pathway.
